summary: Start room = an energy gate inside a trap box (down-pusher into teleports at the floor's west end, teleport strip over the north ledge, exits 87 u above the floor). PPO arms (baseline, 4x novelty, energy everywhere, sid_ref warm start, squashed-entropy fix) all stall at ~250 u (0.4%). --view-ent-squash (b47f38c) fixes the yaw sigma blow-up (2.718 -> ~1.0) but not the gate. Go-Explore phase 1 with energy-height cells (--cell-energy, cedfde3) leaves the room in <1 min of search and reaches 3.2% of the field. Running: Go-Explore phase 2 - pbr1b3_gx1 = recipe + squash + --spawn-states (parent chains of the search's deepest cells, refreshed every 5 min while the search continues).
